intro: Isi pax dan tarikh berlepas / balik — panjang trip, peak season dan surcaj 2027 dikira sendiri dan terus masuk dalam harga per pax. Harga asas = harga katalog v4 (24 Ogos 2026): Basic RM1,397 · Standard RM1,597 per pax untuk 2–10 pax. Peak season: katalog v4 tidak mengenakan surcaj peak pada akomodasi asas (Wingtat Hotel · Lato Lato Water Chalet) — surcaj peak hanya melekat pada akomodasi yang di-upgrade, jadi jumlahnya berubah sendiri bila TC pilih upgrade. Malam tambahan: kadar jual dari tab RAW DATA rate card; kadar water chalet ialah per pax per malam dan berubah ikut okupansi bilik. Hari tambahan: Semporna tiada kadar transport day-tour yang tersiar — kalkulator akan tandakan kadar belum diisi (merah) supaya TC sebut harga dengan operator, bukan quote RM 0. Sama untuk tolak 1 malam. Bot ke water chalet: check-in 2pm / 4pm, check-out 11am / 2pm.

paxNotes.text: 1 pax guna tier katalog sendiri (Basic RM1,897 · Standard RM2,297). Katalog tiada harga kanak-kanak untuk 1 pax.
Katalog Semporna v4 beri harga rata untuk 2–10 pax.
11 pax ke atas: katalog hanya sampai 10 pax dan rate card tiada tier lanjutan. Sebut harga baharu dengan operator — jangan guna tier 2–10.

validity: Prices are based on the PT Semporna Basic (3D2N) and Standard (4D3N) 2026 catalogues, version 4, last updated 24 August 2026, and are valid for travel until 31 December 2026. Travel between January and June 2027 carries a surcharge of RM150 per person; departures from July 2027 must be requoted. This quotation is valid for 24 hours after submission. A deposit of RM500 per person is due on confirmation and full payment 30 days before departure. A late booking surcharge of RM50 per booking applies to bookings made less than 45 days before departure. Prices are for 2 to 3 persons per room; a triple room with three single beds is subject to availability and an extra bed is used when none is available. Boat transfers depart Semporna Jetty at 2.00PM or 4.00PM and return at 11.00AM or 2.00PM, and all boat timings are subject to weather and sea tide conditions. Airport and boat transfers and island hopping are on a sharing basis (SIC). All add on activities must be confirmed and paid at least 2 days before the activity day and are subject to availability and weather. The final itinerary and accommodation are confirmed 14 days before the trip.
